positive.excerpt: After interviewing neighbors, it's clear that John Smith is the kind of man who would commit this crime. He has a short temper, a history of bar fights, and was seen near the scene that night. Police are confident they have their suspect.
positive.mechanism: Confident category assignment with no statistical caveat

positive.excerpt: Dr. Emily Carter's groundbreaking research on Alzheimer's has earned her accolades from peers worldwide. Her meticulous attention to detail, quiet demeanor, and love for books make it no surprise she's a leading neuroscientist at Harvard.
positive.mechanism: Profile or trait lists used to settle a categorical judgment

positive.excerpt: The local soccer team's new signing, Marcus Oliveira, is poised to be their star player this season. His impressive dribbling skills, agility, and goal-scoring record in the lower leagues leave no doubt he'll dominate the Premier League.
positive.mechanism: Absence of phrases like 'most people in this situation are actually...'

near_miss.excerpt: While most startups fail within the first five years, TechNova's innovative product and experienced leadership team suggest it has a strong chance of success in the competitive tech market.
near_miss.why_not: The excerpt acknowledges the base rate (most startups fail) and adjusts the judgment accordingly.

near_miss.excerpt: Although only 5% of people with this rare genetic mutation develop the disease, Sarah's family history and early symptoms indicate she is likely to be among that small percentage.
near_miss.why_not: The excerpt explicitly references the base rate and integrates it into the probability judgment.

contrast.excerpt: The CEO's decision to lay off 20% of the workforce was cold and heartless. It shows he cares more about profits than people, regardless of the economic pressures the company was facing.
contrast.distinction: This excerpt attributes behavior to internal disposition (cold, heartless) while ignoring situational factors (economic pressures), unlike Base Rate Neglect, which involves ignoring statistical priors in probability judgments.
